Hi Samira — great, confirmed for Tue 11/30 at 9:00am PST. I attached a short pre-read and a checklist that covers SDKs, streaming examples, and network requirements. Key items below:

Pre-req summary (top-level):
- Supported SDKs: python-redwood >= 1.5.0, js-redwood >= 0.9.3 (we’ll demo both snippets)
- TLS egress to api.redwood.ai on 443 (outbound only). IPs are dynamic; recommend allowing api.redwood.ai via hostname.
- For low-latency streaming, TCP keepalive and outbound connection reuse helps — we’ll show sample client config.

Attachments: integration-prereqs-checklist.md (includes exact pip/npm install commands + sample env vars)

Agenda (finalized):
- 9:00 — 9:05: intros & goals (Marcus)
- 9:05 — 9:30: SDK integration + streaming patterns (Ava)
- 9:30 — 9:50: function/tool-calling and structured outputs (Neha)
- 9:50 — 10:05: perf/cost tuning and rollout recommendations (Ava)
- 10:05 — 10:15: next steps / mutual action plan (Marcus)

I’ll prepare two short demos: streaming a long clinical note with interim tokens, and a function-calling pattern to enrich patient context (we’ll include the JSON schema example).

See attached pre-read and checklist. I’ll drop a calendar invite once Marcus confirms time in the thread.

Best,
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
